m1-red.title: Author determinism test; confirm it CATCHES divergence (RED)
m1-red.imperative: Write tests/integration/test_utilization_determinism.py exercising REAL run_jobs(run_train_backtest) on a bounded set (1-2 recent_history modules, 2 train years, max_rounds_per_year=1) twice into separate output dirs (Run A background n_workers=1 threads=1; Run B forced n_workers=2 threads=1), asserting byte-identity of model_checkpoint.pt and normalized JSON equality, skipif data absent. Then PROVE it catches divergence: temporarily perturb one run (e.g. flip a train seed / mutate checkpoint bytes) and confirm the test FAILS for the right reason. Capture that failing output.

postconditions.statement: test catches a deliberate divergence (failing output captured); evidence attached

payload.statement: Empirical: real gold-cycle training is NOT bit-reproducible on torch 2.10 CPU (py3.14 Win): two same-seed, single-thread, fixed-hashseed trainings drift ~3e-4. Crucially, 1-worker-vs-2-worker drift (2.8e-4) equals same-path rerun drift (3.1e-4) -> worker count adds NO systematic divergence. Byte-identity of trained weights is unattainable here for reasons external to run_jobs. Test asserts structural byte-identity (order/keys/manifest-modulo-timestamp+path) + tight-tolerance weight/metric agreement; not a production blocker (run_jobs runs the same nondeterministic worker faithfully).

Divergence-catch CONFIRMED two ways: (1) committed test_utilization_determinism_catches_divergence PASSES (seed-perturbed run drifts weights past 1e-2 tol); (2) throwaway monkeypatch reversing Run B job order makes the headline test FAIL on the input-order keys assertion. Also: headline test organically failed twice in dev (manifest numeric drift, metric drift) before normalization was corrected -> assertions are live, not vacuous.

m2-green.title: Test passes on the real pipeline (GREEN)
m2-green.imperative: Remove the perturbation. Run the real determinism test; it must RUN (not skip) and PASS locally where data is present. If it reveals a REAL divergence at fixed threads, STOP and return a BLOCKER (do not patch production).

triage_candidates.statement: Out-of-scope observation: latent-power training is not bit-reproducible run-to-run on torch 2.10 CPU even at single-thread/fixed-seed/fixed-hashseed (~3e-4 weight drift; rank-based backtest metrics swing O(0.1-0.3)). This is orthogonal to run_jobs (worker count adds no extra divergence) but means gold-cycle artifacts are not bit-stable across reruns generally. If bit-stable committed artifacts are ever desired, would need torch.use_deterministic_algorithms + deterministic reductions investigation. Not a G6 concern.
